method: Each section read in full by a machine-assisted reviewer against the packs and the ground catalogue as of this date; not a legal review.

sections.bearsOn: Defines agricultural land, farm use (farming land, plants or animals, or a use the regulation designates), non-farm use, soil (all unconsolidated material above bedrock), fill, soil or fill use, and owner (for Crown land, the government); the ALR screen relies on "owner" and "farm use" to say the Act binds Crown land and that harvest is a farm use.

The Act and its regulations are not subject to other enactments except the Interpretation Act, the Environment and Land Use Act and the Environmental Management Act (and a water sustainability plan regulation), so Forest Act and FRPA powers yield to it on ALR land.

A minister or government agent must not exercise a power under another enactment except in accordance with this Act, so a cutting permit or road permit over ALR land is issued subject to the ALR use rules.
sections.gapNote: The ALR screen cites ss. 20 and 20.3 but not s. 3, the provision that makes Forest Act permits over ALR land subject to the Act; harvest is a farm use, so it matters mainly for roads and fill.

Establishes six administrative regions, including the North region that covers the Omineca.

The Commission may designate land, Crown land included, as agricultural land, which brings it into the ALR; a block area can become ALR land without any forestry decision.
Repealed; no operative text.
Inclusion of land in the ALR on the Commission's initiative or on a local or first nation government's application, with notice and hearing.
Agricultural land leaves the ALR only by exclusion under ss. 29.1(2)(b), 30(1)(a) or 45(1).
Local governments, first nation governments and approving officers may approve non-farm uses, structures, soil or fill uses and subdivisions on ALR land only as the Act permits.
An applicant must notify the Commission before registering a Land Title Act statutory right of way over ALR land.
Registrars must not accept plans or descriptions that subdivide agricultural land unless permitted.

A person must not use agricultural land for a non-farm use unless the Act or the regulation permits it; a holder of a right of entry under an enactment may apply for permission. Timber harvest is a designated farm use, so the restriction bears mainly on roads, pits and other works in the ALR.
Limits residences on ALR parcels to one principal residence of 500 m2 or less unless permitted.
Pre-existing residential structures may continue on stated conditions.

A person must not remove soil from or place fill on agricultural land unless permitted by the Commission or the regulation, or after giving the chief executive officer notice and receiving approval or 60 days' silence; building a block road with imported fill or a borrow pit on ALR land is a soil or fill use.
sections.gapNote: The ALR screen marks roads as "conditions" but no rule asks whether a block road on ALR land will remove soil or bring in fill, or whether a permission or soil and fill notice covers it.
proposedFacts: Will the block's roads or landings remove soil from, or place fill brought from elsewhere on, Agricultural Land Reserve land?
Has the Commission granted permission, or approved a soil and fill notice, for that removal or placement?
